item_verdicts.manifest: the manifest states commits 999fbeb7d and 629105e4d, the three gate arms with their EXIT codes, the 52-file ticker cohort 684 passed at head against 681 at base with the one load-timing retry named, no outside_scope work and no blockers; every figure it states matches the logs it names.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared write paths are reckon/crew/ticker.py, tests/test_a_shown_delivery_is_not_drawn_again_after_its_review_starts.py, the landing fragment and an unused figures directory; git diff --stat 62121960138c..629105e4d changes exactly ticker.py (+53/-3), the new test file and the fragment, nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_shown_delivery_is_not_drawn_again_after_its_review_starts.py:92 fails if the withholding is removed (the base arm prints the extra 'delivered'), and the control at :106 and the resume arm at :140 fail if the memory over-withholds; every assertion compares printed rows against a hardcoded literal rather than a value the test handed in.
justifications.evidence: gate-head.log ends 3 passed EXIT=0 at 629105e4d, base-arm.log reproduces the defect at base as ['working','delivered','in review','delivered'] EXIT=1, and negative-control.log is red on the same two ids with the memory removed; the only unlogged clause is ruff, which I re-ran clean at head.
justifications.fit: the two memories sit in RowPolicy.__init__ beside _shown and _reported, the helpers are private methods on the same class, and the names (_launches, _review_started, _redraws_a_shown_delivery) state the mechanism with no plan or ticket identifiers.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/ticker.py:2139-2144 returns before the same-word rule when _redraws_a_shown_delivery matches, and ticker.py:1711-1713 moves the ordinal only on a launch the pane actually released for the run, so a resume's delivery still prints.
justifications.reuse: a capability search over reckon/crew for an existing attempt-ordinal or review-start memory found none; the change extends RowPolicy, which already owns every row-withholding memory (_shown, _reported, _shown_wait, _held), rather than adding a second filter beside it.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 62121960138c 629105e4d lists only reckon/crew/ticker.py, the new test file and the declared landing fragment, all inside the declared write paths.
